The Defective Detective — Album 3: Serah Contemplates

Where Does This Go

"Where does this go? Nobody knows"

[Verse] Serah’s out Field team gone

Office somehow carries on

Phone line blinking Door won’t close

Twenty-seven cases Nobody knows

Andy’s got the waiting room

Foxxie’s writing intro cues

Coda built a color-coded board

Then immediately ignored it too

[Pre-Chorus] Urgent Pending Paid Unpaid

Missing Fraud Complaint delayed

Andy holds a folder up

“Where does this go?”

Silence

[Chorus] Where does this go? Nobody knows

Top drawer Bottom shelf Maybe under cases closed

Where does this go? Priority low?

If the client’s crying in the hallway Does that make it urgent though?

Where does this go? We need a system fast

Because Serah left for one investigation

And somehow paperwork reproduced en masse

[Verse] Andy’s doing customer care

“Please sit down We’ll get you there.”

Old Kin asks about a missing ring

Someone else reports a haunted thing

Foxxie’s typing scripts beside

“Can I quote you if you don’t mind?”

Coda mutters,

“Not now.”

Then hacks a Company node

While sorting files

Somehow

[Pre-Chorus] Ledger says rent Power due

Coffee fund is missing too

Andy looks at Coda

“Did you pay this?”

“I was busy.”

“With what?”

“Crime.”

[Chorus] Where does this go? Nobody knows

Legal Personal Strange Potential Company overlap

Where does this go? Which stack grows?

If a case sounds completely stupid

But the client already paid

I suppose it stays

[Verse] Foxxie says,

“We need categories.”

Coda says,

“We have categories.”

Andy says,

“No, those are colors.”

Room goes quiet

“Right.”

Different categories

Missing Kin Theft Fraud Threats

Weird things Nessa hasn’t named yet

Company-linked Private dispute

Cases Serah will definitely refuse

[Bridge] Andy writes:

PRIORITY ONE Immediate danger

PRIORITY TWO Missing Kin

PRIORITY THREE Evidence may disappear

PRIORITY FOUR Paid deposit

Foxxie looks up

“Paid deposit should be higher.”

Coda nods

“Electricity agrees.”

Andy sighs

[Break] [Phone rings]

“Serah Solves.”

“No, we cannot make your neighbor fall in love with you.”

Next line

“Serah Solves.”

“No, we cannot prove your boss is secretly a dragon.”

Coda looks up

“Actually…”

Andy points

“No.”

Foxxie laughs into her sleeve

[Pre-Chorus] Files keep coming Bills still stay

Scripts get written Calls get made

Coda hacks Foxxie edits

Andy somehow runs the place

[Chorus] Where does this go? Now we might know

Urgent left Paid ones right Missing cases front row

Where does this go? Label every file

Maybe Serah won’t kill us

If this survives another while

Where does this go? Agency taking shape

One kid One hacker One broadcaster

Holding down the fort today

[Final Chorus][key lift] Where does this go? Somewhere useful now

Every case gets logged and numbered

Every bill gets written down

Where does this go? Maybe this is how

An office turns into an agency

When the boss is not around

Where does this go? Into something real

Not just chaos Not just coffee

Not just one impossible deal

Where does this go? Ask us next week

For now

Take a number

State your problem

And please

Try to keep it brief

[Outro] Andy closes the ledger

Foxxie saves her script

Coda cracks another system

Then files three complaints correctly

Phone rings again

Andy answers

“Serah Solves.”

He looks at the others

[Spoken] [clean voice only]

“Yes.”

“We’re open.”
